text:
maya patel: Heads-up — we need a quick sync on the LangChain + LlamaIndex + GatewayHub integration announcement window. partner legal has a hard embargo for next Tuesday.

jon becker: noted. is the embargo for the joint press release or marketplace listing too?

maya patel: both. GateHub wants the marketplace entry ready, LangChain wants docs and sample app, LlamaIndex wants a sample index + eval.

samira rao: quick context — GatewayHub validated the adapter last week but asked us for a small sample orchestrator demo that shows fallback routing to a quantized variant. can we ship that by monday?

liam chen: depends — infra needs a staging slot to run the demo on Nimbus GPUs. kai, do we have capacity?

kai nguyen: I can carve a short-lived dedicated pool on staging (2xA100 equiv). need a kira ticket with config: model=redwood-gpt-13b-q4, kv_cache=true, prefix_cache=on.

maya patel: assigning: liam -> staging slot + kira ticket; jon -> coordinate LangChain sample app (python + chainlit); samira -> LlamaIndex sample dataset + eval harness; olivia -> marketplace listing draft & legal checklist.

jon becker: I can reuse the snippets from the gateway adapter repo. will add a small Chain example and a README. ETA Monday morning.

samira rao: I'll prepare an eval harness (3 prompts + perf baseline). will run quality regression against current prod model and include results.

liam chen: creating KIRA-4521 now. staging pool request attached. ETA 3 hours.

kai nguyen: thanks. once pool is up, I'll run throughput smoke tests and a short perf report.

olivia park: legal reminder: embargo doc requires exact quote from each partner. need PR review of the marketplace copy by EOD Monday. I'll draft and ping everyone.

maya patel: good. also: planning a quick partner preview call Tue 10am PT. link to calendar in thread after olivia confirms copy.

deploy-bot: Canary preview environment created: preview-gatewayhub-2026-04-12 — URL: https://preview.redwood.ai/preview-gatewayhub-2026-04-12

jon becker: perfect — i'll push the sample app to that preview URL and verify tool-calling.

samira rao: small gotcha: LlamaIndex team asked we surface an embedded similarity score in the demo output. jon — can the sample include that?

jon becker: yes, adding a similarity column to the JSON output.

liam chen: smoke perf numbers: 200rps sustained, p95 latency ~110ms on preview pool (quantized). will attach logs.

maya patel: love it. can everyone reply with a one-line blocker? we'll consolidate for the partner call.

jon becker: blocker: need final version of GatewayHub adapter from eng-runtime (PR #990) merged.

samira rao: blocker: need the seed dataset for index (olivia, can legal clear sharing?)

liam chen: no infra blockers once KIRA-4521 is live.

kai nguyen: ops: can we have a rollback plan if preview exceeds quota? suggest a rate limit rule and fallback route to hosted smaller model.

olivia park: legal: ok to share sanitized seed dataset, I'll upload to shared drive and tag team.

maya patel: actionable summary:
- Jon: sample app + similarity output -> push to preview (mon AM)
- Samira: eval harness + baseline -> run and post results (mon AM)
- Liam: KIRA-4521 -> staging pool (in progress)
- Kai: perf smoke -> report (after pool ready)
- Olivia: marketplace copy + embargo doc -> draft for review (EOD Mon)
- Maya: schedule partner preview call Tue 10am PT

maya patel: if no blockers by EOD Monday we'll finalize for the embargo. thanks all :pray: 

jon becker: ack :thumbsup:

samira rao: ack

liam chen: ack

kai nguyen: ack

olivia park: ack

maya patel: adding checklist snippet for anyone editing the marketplace doc:
```
- Partner assets collected (logo, quotes, tech contact)
- Sample app link (preview URL)
- Eval results + baseline table
- API usage example + SDK snippet
- Embargo date/time + approved quote
```

maya patel: i'll post the calendar invite after olivia confirms copy. ping me in thread for urgent updates.
